# Tool reference

- **Default**: exposed without `-tools`. Opt-in groups are enabled with `-tools default,groups` (or `all`).
- **Read-only**: available without `-write`.
- **Approval**: with `-write`, the call follows the target chat's send policy (`wpp-mcp access send`): `confirm` (the default unless `-confirm-sends=false`) makes it a proposal you approve with `wpp-mcp outbox`, `direct` acts at once, `none` refuses it. Tools without a chat use the default.
- **Chat access**: which chats the tool can reach under the access policy.

## core

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `digest` | yes | yes |  | authorised chats only | Summarise recent activity: for every authorised chat with messages after a cut-off, the number of matching messages and the most recent ones, most active first, optionally only unread ones, ones that mention you, or ones matching keywords, grouped by chat or by sender. |
| `download_media` | yes | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Fetch the encrypted media payload (image, video, audio, document) for a previously-cached message, decrypt it, and write it to a local file under the store directory; returns the absolute path. |
| `get_chat` | yes | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Fetch metadata for a single cached chat by JID. |
| `get_chat_notes` | yes | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Read a chat's living notes (a summary kept by you across conversations) together with the cached messages that arrived after the notes were last updated, including cached audio transcripts and image text. |
| `get_message_context` | yes | yes |  | authorised chats only | Fetch a specific cached message and the surrounding messages in its chat. |
| `get_poll_results` | yes | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Return the current vote tally for a cached poll. |
| `get_status` | yes | yes |  | none (no chat content) | Report the WhatsApp connection state and its transition time, paired account, and read-only mode. |
| `list_chats` | yes | yes |  | authorised chats only | List cached WhatsApp chats (1:1 and group), optionally filtered by name substring and sorted by recency or alphabetic name. |
| `list_messages` | yes | yes |  | authorised chats only | Search and page through cached WhatsApp messages, optionally filtering by chat, sender, time range and words (accent-insensitive full-text search); can include surrounding context messages. |
| `mark_unread` | yes | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Move a chat's local read mark back so digest with only_unread shows its messages again: from message_id onward, or the whole chat when message_id is omitted. |
| `pairing_status` | yes | yes |  | none (no chat content) | Report the WhatsApp device-pairing state as a structured `setup_state` envelope. |
| `request_sync` | yes | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Ask WhatsApp servers to backfill historical messages for a chat into the local cache; messages arrive asynchronously and become queryable via list_messages once delivered. |
| `search_contacts` | yes | yes |  | authorised chats only | Search the cached WhatsApp contact list by case-insensitive substring of name or phone number. |
| `update_chat_notes` | yes | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Save a chat's living notes after merging new messages into them. |

## access

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `request_chat_access` | yes | yes |  | none (no chat content) | Ask the user to authorise a chat you cannot see. |

## messaging

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `delete_message` | yes |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Revoke (delete-for-everyone) a message; recipients see a `message was deleted` notice and the local cache row is marked deleted (with the time) and keeps its text and media. |
| `edit_message` | yes |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Edit a previously-sent text message in place; recipients see the new body with an `edited` label and the cached row takes the new body. |
| `mark_chat_read` | yes |  |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Ack the most recent incoming messages in a chat to clear its unread badge; senders receive read receipts (subject to their privacy settings). |
| `mark_read` | yes |  |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Mark specific incoming messages as read; senders receive read receipts (subject to their privacy settings) and the chat's unread badge decrements. |
| `schedule_message` | yes |  | yes | chat in `recipient` | Schedule a WhatsApp text message for the daemon to send at a future time (at most 30 days ahead); nothing is sent now. |
| `send_audio_message` | yes |  | yes | chat in `recipient` | Send an audio file as a WhatsApp voice note (waveform UI, push-to-play); non-ogg inputs are transcoded via ffmpeg before upload. |
| `send_file` | yes |  | yes | chat in `recipient` | Upload and send a picture, video, document, or raw audio attachment via WhatsApp; the recipient sees a media message and the outgoing row is persisted to the local cache. |
| `send_message` | yes |  | yes | chat in `recipient` | Send a new WhatsApp text message to a person or group; recipients see it as a fresh message from the paired account and the row is also stored in the local cache. |
| `send_reaction` | yes |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Add or replace an emoji reaction on an existing message; recipients see the small emoji badge attached to the original message. |
| `send_reply` | yes |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Send a text message that visibly quotes a previous message; recipients see the new text with the quoted message attached. |

## transcribe

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `extract_image_text` | yes | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Extract the text in an image message (or a PNG, JPEG or WebP document) with local Tesseract OCR; downloads the image if it is not cached, recognises it on this machine without uploading it anywhere, and caches the text without changing the WhatsApp account. |
| `transcribe_audio` | yes |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Transcribe an audio message using the configured speech-to-text service; downloads the audio, uploads it to that service, and caches the transcript without changing the WhatsApp account. |

## labels

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `get_chat_labels` | yes | yes |  | chat in `jid` | List the WhatsApp Business labels attached to one chat. |
| `list_chats_by_label` | yes | yes |  | authorised chats only | List the chats that carry a given WhatsApp Business label, most recently active first. |
| `list_labels` | yes | yes |  | authorised chats only | List the WhatsApp Business labels cached from the paired account, each with its id, name, colour index and the number of chats carrying it. |
| `resync_labels` | yes | yes |  | none (no chat content) | Force a full re-fetch of the account's app state from WhatsApp so labels and label assignments are re-captured into the local cache. |

## contacts

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `is_on_whatsapp` |  | yes |  | none (no chat content) | Query WhatsApp servers to check which of the supplied phone numbers are registered on WhatsApp; the queried users are not notified. |
| `send_contact_card` |  |  | yes | chat in `recipient` | Send a WhatsApp contact card; recipients see a tappable contact entry they can save to their address book and the outgoing message is persisted to the local cache. |

## groups

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `create_group` |  |  | yes | none (no chat content) | Create a new WhatsApp group with the given name and initial participants; the paired user becomes admin and listed participants receive a `you were added` system message in the new chat. |
| `get_group_info` |  | yes |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Fetch live group metadata (subject, topic, participants with admin flags, announce/locked settings, invite config) for the given group JID. |
| `get_group_invite_link` |  |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Return a group's current invite link, or revoke and mint a fresh one when `reset=true`. |
| `join_group_with_link` |  |  | yes | none (no chat content) | Join a WhatsApp group via a `chat.whatsapp.com/<code>` invite URL or the bare invite code; existing members see a `joined via invite link` system message and the new chat appears for the paired user. |
| `leave_group` |  |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Leave a WhatsApp group; remaining members see a `you left` system message and the paired user loses access to all future messages in the chat. |
| `list_groups` |  | yes |  | authorised chats only | List every WhatsApp group the paired user is currently a member of, fetched live from WhatsApp. |
| `set_group_announce` |  |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Toggle announce-only mode on a group; when enabled, non-admin send attempts are rejected by WhatsApp servers and members see a system message about the change. |
| `set_group_locked` |  |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Toggle locked mode on a group; when enabled, only admins can change name/topic/icon and members see a system message about the change. |
| `set_group_name` |  |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Change a group's display name (its `subject`); members see a system message naming the new subject. |
| `set_group_topic` |  |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Change a group's description/topic; members see a system message indicating the description was updated. |
| `update_group_participants` |  |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Add, remove, promote, or demote participants of a group after first checking that the paired user is a group admin (or, for `add`, that the group lets every member add) — if not, it fails and nothing changes. |

## privacy

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `block_contact` |  |  | yes | none (no chat content) | Block a contact so they can no longer send the paired user messages or see your last seen, profile photo, or status; the blocked contact is not explicitly notified but will see undelivered messages on their side. |
| `get_blocklist` |  | yes |  | none (no chat content) | Fetch the paired user's current WhatsApp blocklist from the server. |
| `get_privacy_settings` |  | yes |  | none (no chat content) | Fetch the paired user's current WhatsApp privacy settings from the server. |
| `send_presence` |  |  |  | none (no chat content) | Set the paired user's own global online availability; contacts permitted by privacy settings see `online` or last-seen accordingly. |
| `send_typing` |  |  |  | chat in `chat_jid` | Show or hide the per-chat typing or recording presence indicator; the recipient sees a transient `typing...` or `recording audio...` hint that auto-expires after roughly 25 seconds. |
| `set_privacy_setting` |  |  | yes | none (no chat content) | Change a single WhatsApp privacy knob (read-receipts, last-seen, online, group-add, etc.) for the paired account; takes effect immediately and may change who can see your activity or contact you. |
| `set_status_message` |  |  | yes | none (no chat content) | Update the paired user's WhatsApp profile `About` text; contacts permitted by privacy settings see the new text on the profile screen. |
| `unblock_contact` |  |  | yes | none (no chat content) | Unblock a previously blocked contact, restoring their ability to message the paired user and see your last seen/profile/status; the contact is not notified. |

## polls

| Tool | Default | Read-only | Approval | Chat access | Description |
|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|---|---|
| `send_poll` |  |  | yes | chat in `recipient` | Send a new WhatsApp poll message with 2 to 32 options; recipients see a votable poll card and an outgoing row plus poll metadata is persisted locally so votes can be tallied. |
| `send_poll_vote` |  |  | yes | chat in `chat_jid` | Cast or re-cast a vote on a previously-seen poll; each call replaces the caller's prior vote on that poll, and the new tally is broadcast to the chat. |
